high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for an exclusive announcement about actors Jacob Elordi and Lily-Rose Depp starring in a film adaptation of Cormac McCarthy's work titled "Outer Dark." The graphic has a split design with two headshots of the actors on either side. Left Side: The person is a male with dark, curly hair styled upwards. He is wearing a black sweater with a small red logo on the left side of his chest. The background behind him is a solid blue color. Right Side: The person is a female with light brown hair pulled back
